name: Great San Francisco earthquake
notes: Deaths long cited as ~700 but USGS/modern research estimates ~3,000. Fire caused most loss.

name: San Fermin earthquake & tsunami
notes: Puerto Rico (US territory). ~40 of the deaths from the tsunami. Reported tolls range 76-144.

name: Long Beach earthquake
notes: Death toll usually cited 115-120; spurred the Field Act (school seismic standards).

name: Aleutian Islands earthquake & Pacific tsunami
notes: Tsunami killed ~159 in Hilo, Hawaii + lighthouse crew at Scotch Cap, AK. Prompted Pacific Tsunami Warning System.

name: Lituya Bay earthquake & megatsunami
notes: Triggered the tallest tsunami ever recorded (~524 m runup).

name: Hebgen Lake earthquake
notes: Landslide buried Rock Creek campground; created Quake Lake.

name: Great Alaska (Good Friday) earthquake
notes: 2nd-largest quake ever recorded. ~124 deaths from tsunamis (AK, OR, CA).

name: San Fernando (Sylmar) earthquake
notes: Hospital collapses drove major seismic building-code reform.

name: Loma Prieta earthquake
notes: Struck during the World Series; Cypress Structure & Bay Bridge collapses.

name: Northridge earthquake
notes: Deaths cited 57-72. One of the costliest US disasters (~$20B+).

name: Nisqually earthquake
notes: Single death attributed to a heart attack.

name: Mineral (Virginia) earthquake
notes: Felt by more people than any US quake in history; damaged Washington Monument.

name: Ridgecrest earthquake sequence
notes: Largest in Southern CA in 20 years; ~1 indirect death reported.

name: Puerto Rico earthquake sequence
notes: Some sources cite up to 4 deaths incl. indirect. Damaged Guanica/Indios region.
